reason: Both sets frame Orc1 removal in the same pre-RC licensing / E2F / G1-S replication contexts, but B spreads them over 25 heavily overlapping variants (several identical to A's themes) with only marginal additions such as break-induced-replication and p53/senescence mixes, whereas A gives a clean nested ladder from origin licensing to the whole cell cycle.

A already covers the real GH facets (JAK-STAT cytokine-receptor family, IGF/body growth and lifespan, thyroid, somatostatin/GH secretion, feeding/leptin, HPA/steroid axis) in 17 themes, while B repeats these as 33 near-duplicate IGF-growth, appetite and IL-6/STAT variants and adds little beyond a minor IGFBP touch.

A covers the core AKT2 contexts (PI3K/AKT activation, insulin receptor signalling and attenuation, GLUT4 translocation, glucagon/PKA counter-regulation, beta-cell secretion, adipocyte metabolism) compactly, whereas B's useful extras (glycogen/glycolysis themes, AKT-TSC/RAS) come buried among many near-duplicate insulin-response variants.

A adds the contexts that matter most for p16-CDK4/6 failure, namely the joint p53/RB G1-arrest theme and the broad CDK4/6-RB-E2F cell-cycle theme, whereas B's ladder grows only into p53 apoptosis and death-receptor contexts and drops the cell-cycle level, despite A having some redundant senescence variants.

B gives a clean 9-step nested ladder (cushion EMT/AV valve, valves plus septation, outflow tract, myocardium, whole heart, vasculature), whereas A repeats the same valve/septum contexts in about 19 near-duplicate variants; A's extra AV-canal and BMP themes do not make up for that clutter.

A covers telomerase recruitment, Cajal-body/TCAB1 trafficking, TRiC chaperonin folding, telomere end processing/capping/ALT, snoRNA/rRNA modification and DNA repair once each, whereas B repeats these as many overlapping telomere and RNA-modification variants and adds less relevant spliceosome and Pol I/III transcription themes.
